[quote=north_arenenge;57754386]I dont know how it works? Like the voting system? The category of laws? How they will be enforced? Benefits? Motivations? Goal? [/quote]

The voting system is simple. There are regular member states and states within the Council of Five, regular member states are given one vote during voting sessions and do not have any other powers than that, however states on the Council of Five can attempt to veto a voting session or bill, if two states within the Council of Five vote to veto an action then that action will be vetoed. Voting works in majority, for a bill to be passed, it has to have the support of 3/4 of the LSS as well as not be vetoed by the Council of Five. 

There will be Human Rights Laws, Laws of War, Laws of Diplomacy, Laws of Nations, Laws Regarding Refugees and Humanitarian Crises, Maritime Laws, Resource Laws, and Space Laws. 

The UREV has a powerful military of Enforcers, UREV Enforcers will be the primary way on how laws are upheld by states that do not follow them. However an international coalition will be formed so that any nation can volunteer troops to enforce international law. But for now, UREV Enforcers are the primary force.

Benefits are you get to cooperate with other states, get to choose and vote upon laws, and get diplomatic benefits.

The motivation is to create a UN for Erene basically.

Goal is the same as UN, upholding peace and international law.
